sources.snippet: We introduce InternVL 3.5, a new family of open-source multimodal models that significantly advances versatility, reasoning capability, and inference efficiency along the InternVL series. A key innovation is the Cascade Reinforcement Learning (Cascade RL) framework, which enhances reasoning through a two-stage process: offline RL for stable convergence and online RL for refined alignment. sources.title: InternVL3.5
sources.snippet: For the Flash version of InternVL3.5, we additionally introduce a lightweight training stage, termed Visual Consistency Learning (ViCO), which reduces the token cost required to represent an image patch. Here, we also open-source the model weights after different training stages for potential research usage.

sources.title: InternVL3.5: Advancing Open-Source Multimodal Models in Versatility ...
sources.snippet: Notably, our largest model, i.e., InternVL3.5-241B-A28B, attains state-of-the-art results among open-source MLLMs across general multimodal, reasoning, text, and agentic tasks—narrowing the performance gap with leading commercial models like GPT-5. All models and code are publicly released.
